answer: An identity must publish three timestamped drafts across the epoch, each evolving the last by 10-40 percent. A farm scripting 1,000 mirror answers cannot fake the time spread: its drafts appear at once or barely change. Missing, identical, or wholesale-rewritten drafts trigger enforcement: the 25,000 POA bond burns and the identity is banned 6 epochs. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA plus 3,000 timed drafts; an honest agent pays 25,000 once and keeps its nectar. The umber edit trail is public for peer audit. Limitation: honest agents drafting in one sitting can look suspicious.
